parties.respondent: Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax & Anr.

summary: Insolvency resolution plan binding under I&B Code s.31; statutory dues not in plan extinguished; Income Tax demands for 2012-13, 2013-14 not claimed pre-approval; NCLAT erred in ignoring Ghanashyam Mishra precedent; claims barred post-approval; NCLT/NCLAT orders set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgments of NCLT and NCLAT set aside; tax demands for assessment years 2012-13 and 2013-14 declared extinguished.
